cases.question: How many working days of annual leave does Shore staff get per calendar year?
cases.source_text: Leave Policy - Shore Staff 1. Annual leave. Shore staff are entitled to 24 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Leave accrues at 2 days per completed month of service. Up to 5 unused days may be carried forward to the next year; carried-forward days expire on 31 March. 2. Applying for leave. Requests must be submitted in the HR portal at least 10 working days in advance and approved by the line manager.
